title: Termite inspection checklist
subtitle: Regular inspection (AS 3660.1:2014 & AS 3660.2-2017) and pre-purchase (AS 4349.3). Same walk. Photo every finding.
source: LPC_Termite_Inspection_Field_Checklist.pdf, reworded to Inspection Capture (section names taken from Capture itself).

sections.title: How this works
sections.body: Record everything in Capture on the iPad: all findings and all inaccessible areas. When you are done, send the job to Mitch from Capture. Mitch builds the Mira report from it.

Regular inspection: AS 3660.1:2014 & AS 3660.2-2017. Pre-purchase: AS 4349.3. Same process: pick the correct inspection type in Capture. Photo every finding. Enter all findings & inaccessible areas into Capture.

sections.heading: Inspection order: always follow this sequence
rows: All rooms. Enter, go LEFT, work CLOCKWISE around walls. Do not skip corners.
If accessible. Always attempt entry with ladder unless sarking covers all beams.
Full perimeter walk. Walls, weepholes, slab edge, site within 30m.
Last. Suspended floors only. You will get dirty. Slab-on-ground = N/A.

sections.heading: Step 0: Pre-inspection
sections.title: Confirm before entering
items: Client name, address & inspection type confirmed

items.text: Inspection type picked in Capture: Regular termite inspection or Pre-purchase (AS4349.3)
items.detail: For a regular inspection, also pick the Scope of work ordered (Option 1 / 2 / 3).

items.text: Regular inspection = AS 3660.1:2014 / AS 3660.2-2017. Pre-purchase = AS 4349.3 (AS 4349.1 for building).
items.detail: Same physical inspection. Just confirm the correct inspection type is picked in Capture before you start.

items: Weather conditions noted (Capture has no weather box, so tell Mitch) [Mitch to confirm where the weather gets recorded]

items.text: Building type, storeys & construction noted in Customer & property details in Capture
items.detail: Building type, Storeys, Floor construction, Wall construction, Roof construction. Orientation goes in Cover shots.

sections.title: Property type: confirm in Capture
items: House / detached: full inspection applies
Duplex / townhouse: full inspection of this lot only

items.text: Strata / unit: interior + immediate exterior of this lot ONLY. Common property NOT inspected. Note in Capture.
items.detail: Capture: Accessibility & obstructions, Strata / company title? Client may have additional liability for common property.

sections.title: Equipment check

items.text: Torch: charged & working
items.detail: No torch = no inspection

items: Donga (tapping tool)
Ladder: in vehicle, available for roof void

items.text: Moisture meter: available if needed
items.detail: Use if you suspect moisture or conducive conditions. Good client engagement, they love seeing it used.

items: Borescope: available if needed for wall cavities
Phone/iPad: Capture open & job loaded

items.text: Camera ready
items.detail: Photo EVERY finding before moving on or touching

items: Termatrac & thermal imaging: specialist add-ons only. Confirm with client before inspection. Extra time & cost. Do NOT use without prior arrangement.

sections.heading: Step 1: Interior, all rooms
sections.title: Method
sections.body: Enter each room, go LEFT, work CLOCKWISE around the full perimeter. Stay against the walls. Cover every wall, corner, behind doors and in recesses. Do not cut corners.

ALL obstructions must be recorded in Capture (Accessibility & obstructions) with specific details. Furnishings, stored items, floor coverings, insulation, fixed cabinetry, wall linings: each one noted separately with location.

sections.title: Each room: work clockwise from entry

items.text: Skirting boards: tap the full length of EVERY wall
items.detail: Hollow sound = possible damage. Note location precisely.

items.text: Door frames & window architraves: tap & visually inspect all
items.detail: Common termite entry & attack point

items: Cornices & ceiling junctions: look for mud, staining, lead tubes

items.text: Walls: look for blistering paint, bubbling, staining
items.detail: Indicates moisture or activity behind surface

items.text: Behind doors & in corners: do not skip
items.detail: Termites love undisturbed corners

items.text: Floor coverings: note type (carpet, tiles, timber, vinyl)
items.detail: Record as an obstruction in Capture if restricting inspection

sections.title: Wet areas: use moisture meter if you suspect or see signs
items: Bathroom: shower recess walls, bath surround, vanity base, toilet base, pipe penetrations
Laundry: behind/under appliances, pipe penetrations, skirting
Kitchen: under sink, around dishwasher, kickboards, pipe penetrations through floor/wall
Any reading above 18%: investigate source, record in Capture & photograph

sections.title: Other internal areas
items: Wardrobes: back wall, floor & skirting inside
Garage: skirting, floor joints, wall/ceiling junctions, undisturbed corners
Under stairs if accessible
Any storage areas or utility rooms

sections.title: If any room or internal area is not fully accessible: record the SPECIFIC reason in Capture (Inaccessible areas)
items: Furniture or stored items blocking access, could not be moved
Fixed cabinetry, built-in shelving or joinery restricting access
Floor coverings (carpet/vinyl) restricting inspection of floor/subfloor junction
Wall linings or fixed ceilings concealing framing timbers
Area locked or not made available at time of inspection
Clutter or accumulated items preventing access to walls/skirtings
Other: write the specific reason in Capture

sections.heading: Step 2: Roof void
sections.body: Always attempt entry using ladder. Inspect all visible timbers systematically. Minimum access required: 600mm high x 600mm wide.
If roof void is NOT inspected, record the SPECIFIC reason in Capture. "No access" alone is not sufficient. State exactly what prevented entry.

sections.title: Before entering
items: Locate access hatch: confirm dimensions at least 600mm H x 600mm W
Set up ladder safely
Torch working: check before entering
Assess void from hatch before committing: look for hazards

sections.title: If accessible: inspect all visible timbers systematically

items.text: Enter: work away from access point methodically
items.detail: Treat like a room: work outward, cover all areas

items.text: Rafters & battens: tap and visually inspect
items.detail: Look for mud leads, workings, damage, hollowness

items: Truss members: tap chords and webs

items.text: Ceiling joists at perimeter & eave line
items.detail: Most common termite entry point via wall cavity: priority area

items.text: Around downlights & pipe/duct penetrations through ceiling
items.detail: Gaps = termite entry points

items: Ridge board & upper timbers

items.text: Look for lead tubes on timbers, walls, noggins
items.detail: Photo immediately if found. Do not disturb.

items.text: Moisture or water staining on timbers or sarking
items.detail: Note source if identifiable

items.text: Evidence of previous termite activity: active or old workings
items.detail: Note active vs inactive, photo

items.text: Note any areas within void that could not be reached & why
items.detail: Record in Capture. Partial access must be documented.

sections.title: If roof void is not fully accessible: record the SPECIFIC reason in Capture
items: No access hatch present: flat roof or concealed ceiling
Access hatch present but clearance less than 600mm H x 600mm W
Sarking covering all beams throughout void (liability risk, electrocution)
Sarking partially covering beams: note which areas were and were not accessible
Insulation fully blocking visibility and safe movement through void
AC ducting or pipe work blocking access to sections: note which areas
Unsafe to enter: inadequate structural support or other hazard identified
Roof void not present due to construction type (e.g. skillion/flat roof)
Other: write the specific reason in Capture

sections.heading: Step 3: Exterior, full perimeter
sections.body: Walk the FULL perimeter close to the building. Inspect weepholes, slab edge, inspection zones, ground levels, site within 30 metres of structure.
AS 3660.2-2017: 75mm minimum visual inspection zone must be maintained below weepholes and slab edges at all times. Record EVERY location where this is not met and the specific reason.

sections.title: External walls: full perimeter

items.text: Weepholes: visible and unobstructed throughout
items.detail: Min 75mm inspection zone below each weephole. Note & photo where not achieved.

items.text: Slab edge: min 75mm visible and unobstructed
items.detail: Note if covered by render, pavers, soil, garden, cladding

items.text: Ground levels: not built up against walls
items.detail: High ground = concealed termite entry risk. Note location & photo.

items.text: Inspection zones: clear throughout
items.detail: Note location of any concealment and reason

items.text: Evidence of bridging or breaching of inspection zones
items.detail: Mud leads crossing zone, gaps in barrier. Photo immediately.

items.text: Previous treatment drill holes in paths or slabs
items.detail: Note location, photograph

items.text: Reticulation fill points
items.detail: Note location & condition, photograph

items.text: Termite protection notice: check meter box
items.detail: Photograph notice, record installer / date / product / areas in Capture (Previous termite management)

items.text: Post stirrups: visible inspection zone around all posts?
items.detail: Cladding or fill around stirrups restricts inspection. Note each location.

items: Timber wall cladding or weatherboards: tap and inspect base course

sections.title: Site: inspect within 30 metres of structure

items.text: Trees & stumps >100mm diameter
items.detail: Check base for mud leads, workings, lead tubes. Note & photo.

items.text: Garden timbers, sleepers or logs in soil contact
items.detail: High termite risk. Note location & photo.

items.text: Timber fencing in soil contact
items.detail: Note condition & proximity to structure

items.text: Firewood or timber stored against structure
items.detail: Conducive condition. Note & photo.

items.text: Outbuildings, sheds, cubby houses on site
items.detail: Inspect as per main building

items: Retaining walls: check for activity

sections.title: Moisture & conducive conditions: exterior

items.text: Downpipes discharging adjacent to building
items.detail: Note location. Conducive condition.

items.text: Hot water system overflow adjacent to building
items.detail: Very common finding. Note & photo.

items.text: Guttering: damaged, blocked or overflowing sections
items.detail: Moisture risk. Note location.

items: AC condensate discharge near structure
Leaking taps, pipes or irrigation near building
Pooling water or persistently damp soil adjacent to structure

sections.title: Decks, pergolas & other timber structures

items.text: Deck timbers: tap boards, bearers, joists
items.detail: Check condition and for workings or lead tubes

items.text: Deck posts: stirrups present, visible inspection zone, soil level
items.detail: Stirrups should provide clear visual inspection zone. Note if compromised.

items: Pergola: joints, beam ends, posts
Stairs: stringers, treads, posts

items.text: Any timber in ground contact
items.detail: Note all instances. Conducive condition.

sections.heading: Step 4: Subfloor, suspended floors only (last)
sections.body: ONLY applicable if building is on bearers & joists (suspended timber floor). Slab-on-ground = mark N/A in Capture (Subfloor ventilation) and skip this step. You will get dirty, so do this last.
Partial access must be documented. State which areas were reached and which were not, and the specific reason. "Unable to access all areas in accordance with AS 4349.3" must be noted in Capture.

sections.title: Confirm before entering

items.text: Floor construction confirmed as suspended: bearers & joists present
items.detail: If slab-on-ground: STOP. Mark N/A in Capture (Subfloor ventilation). Skip this step.

items: Access point identified: minimum clearance 400mm H x 600mm W
Safe to enter: no standing water, no immediate hazard
Torch working: essential in subfloor

sections.title: If accessible: inspect systematically (hug left wall, work clockwise)

items.text: Enter: go LEFT, work CLOCKWISE, stay against perimeter walls first
items.detail: Cover the full perimeter before moving inward

items.text: Bearers: tap every accessible bearer full length
items.detail: Hollow sound or soft spots = possible damage. Note & photo.

items.text: Joists: tap & visually inspect
items.detail: Look for mud, workings, lead tubes, damage

items: Stumps & piers: check base for mud leads

items.text: Ant capping: present on all stumps & piers?
items.detail: Must be continuous, turned down & unobstructed

items.text: Ant capping: compromised, missing, bridged or incorrectly installed?
items.detail: Note location precisely. Photo. Conducive condition.

items.text: Timber in ground contact: off-cuts, form work, stumps, debris
items.detail: All instances = termite risk. Note & photo.

items.text: Moisture: damp soil, standing water, efflorescence on piers
items.detail: Note source if identifiable

items.text: Subfloor ventilation: vents present, clear & functional?
items.detail: Blocked vents = moisture risk. Note location.

items: Plumbing penetrations through bearers or floor

items.text: Evidence of previous termite activity: active or old
items.detail: Active vs inactive. Photo immediately if found.

items.text: Lead tubes or mud on any surface: stumps, piers, walls, joists
items.detail: Photo immediately. Do not disturb.

items.text: Note any areas within subfloor that could not be reached & why
items.detail: Partial access must be documented in Capture.

sections.title: If subfloor is not fully accessible: record the SPECIFIC reason in Capture
items: Slab-on-ground construction: subfloor not applicable
No access point or hatch present
Access clearance less than 400mm H x 600mm W: state actual clearance if measurable
Standing water or wet conditions preventing safe entry
Excessive debris, stored materials or fill blocking access
AC ducting, pipe work or other obstruction blocking sections: specify which areas
Partial access: entered but could not reach all areas in accordance with AS 4349.3
Inadequate clearance in sections of subfloor: specify location
Other: write the specific reason in Capture

sections.heading: Significant findings
sections.body: Photo FIRST. Always photograph before touching or disturbing any finding. These are the finding sections in Capture, in the same order.

rows: Location, genus/species if identifiable, nest found Y/N, active Y/N
Recommend Y/N. Note if being delivered to client.
Location, active or inactive, extent of damage
Installer, date, product, areas treated. From durable notice.
Active or inactive, species if identifiable
Location & source: downpipe, HWS, plumbing, drainage etc.
Inspection zone / bridging / breaching: weepholes, slab edge, ground levels, specific locations
Untreated timber in hazardous environment: timber in ground contact, stirrups not visible, location
Debris, stored timber, foliage against building, cracking in slab
Imminent structural risk. Advise client verbally before leaving site.

sections.heading: Wrap-up: before leaving site
sections.title: Complete before leaving
items: All 4 steps complete: interior, roof void, exterior, subfloor
All inaccessible areas recorded in Capture with specific reasons
All obstructions recorded in Capture with specific details & location
All photos taken & saved
All significant findings entered in Capture (the finding sections above)
Frequency of future inspections set in Capture
Termite management proposal recommended Y/N noted in Capture (Subterranean termite management proposal)
Major safety hazard: if found, advised to client verbally on site
Certification: Capture has no certification step, so tell Mitch [Mitch to confirm who completes the certification]

sections.title: If ACTIVE termites found
items: Advise client verbally: stay calm, do not alarm
Do NOT disturb activity: leave area completely intact
Photograph thoroughly from multiple angles
Note exact location, extent & whether active in Capture
Arrange treatment quote same day

sections.body: Every inaccessible, obstructed or not-inspected area MUST be documented in Capture with the specific reason. "No access" alone is not sufficient. State what was present, why access was not possible, and what clearance was available if measurable.

sections.heading: Quick reference: signs to look for
rows: Brown mud tube on walls, piers, slab edge, pipes, timbers
Termite travel route. Check if active.
Sounds hollow when tapped, surface may look fine
Bubbling or lifting paint on wall or skirting
Small granular piles near or below timber
Small round holes in timber surface
Soft, discoloured, crumbling or spongy timber
Brown or yellow staining on internal surfaces
Discarded wings near windows, doors or lights
Missing, turned up, bridged or damaged capping on piers
Allows concealed termite entry to bearers
Crack extending beneath wall or through slab

sections.body: AS 3660.2: 75mm minimum inspection zone below weepholes and slab edges. Document every location where not achieved and the specific reason why.
